about.title: Healthcare that feels clear, fast, and close to home
about.lead: Tenadam brings medicine, doctor appointments, and community giving into one simple experience, built for Ethiopia's cities and towns.
about.orderMedicineText: Browse trusted medications and have them delivered without the usual pharmacy back-and-forth.
about.bookCareText: Find doctors by specialty and book a visit in a few taps, with your appointment history always on hand.
about.giveHopeText: Support individuals and organizations doing life-changing work in communities across the country.
about.missionText1: We believe getting care shouldn't be complicated. Tenadam is built to keep the essentials simple: clear pricing, fast checkout, and a straightforward way to book the appointments that matter.
about.missionText2: We're just getting started, and we're building this with the communities we serve in mind.

contact.title: We'd love to hear from you
contact.lead: Questions about an order, an appointment, or a donation? Reach out through whichever channel works best for you.
contact.emailResponse: We usually reply within one business day
